question: What additional attainments belong to the root Kaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: The conjunction links these to prior attainments.
Attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
inference: The eight attainments, including the attainment of powers, constitute the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact referents of the eight items depend on the preceding verses.
plain_english: And the eight, along with the attainment of powers, are the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
